description: The fixed problem P3 of the 3D pigment experiments (docs/design_3d.md, model A): the 2D problem P (1024 x 1024 cells on the 1 x 1 basin, 100 steps, the same flow and pigment settings) with 64 layers over a depth of 0.0625, so the cells are cubes (dx = dy = dz = 1/1024): 67 million cells. The blob is centred at mid-depth. The flow is frozen (--freeze-flow) and starts at rest, so no Poisson solve runs and the timed loop is the 3D pigment update and its halo exchanges alone; with the flow live, the 2D CG of experiments 1 to 5 would take most of the time again. As for P, time one run on Vanda first and adjust nz or steps here.
